integrity: Proof reconstructed from explicit affine charts, integral Gysin and self-intersection formulas, Chow localization and exact standalone finite-field checks; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: No full homotopy type or integral motive is asserted.
Integral cohomology is for the complex variety; finite-field point counts use the common algebraic model.
Full-text literature coverage is incomplete for the final pages of arXiv:2610.05344 and older affine-modification sources.
title: Integral cohomology and Chow rings of a smooth affine quotient family
